title: Renegotiating the Lease Before It's Too Late
script: Ratna: [thoughtful] Pak Joko, thank you for making time. I wanted to talk before the lease renewal notice arrives, rather than scrambling once it does.
Pak Joko: Of course. I assume this is about the rent increase mentioned in the email my agent sent last week.
Ratna: [carefully] It is. A twelve percent rise feels steep, especially given that the building's maintenance has been rather inconsistent lately.
Pak Joko: Property taxes have gone up considerably, and honestly, I've been absorbing those costs myself for the past two years.
Ratna: [reflective] I don't doubt that costs have risen for you too, but the leaking pipe in the hallway was reported three months ago and still hasn't been fixed.
Pak Joko: That's a fair point, and I'll admit it should have been dealt with sooner than it was.
Ratna: [honestly] What I'm proposing is this: a smaller increase, say six percent, contingent on outstanding repairs being completed within a month.
Pak Joko: That's not unreasonable, provided you're willing to sign for two years rather than the usual twelve months.
Ratna: [gently] A longer commitment in exchange for a fairer rate does make sense, assuming the repairs actually happen this time.
Pak Joko: I'll have the plumber come this week, and I'll put the six percent figure in writing before you commit to anything.
Ratna: [calmly] I'd also appreciate a clause stating future increases won't exceed inflation, so we're not renegotiating from scratch every year.
Pak Joko: That's a reasonable safeguard, even if it limits my flexibility somewhat down the line.
Ratna: [encouraging] I've genuinely enjoyed living here, which is precisely why I'd rather resolve this than start apartment hunting all over again.
Pak Joko: I'd rather keep a tenant who reports problems calmly than deal with the uncertainty of an empty unit.
Ratna: [seriously] Then it seems we both have an incentive to make this arrangement work smoothly for once.
Pak Joko: Agreed. I'll draft the updated contract by Friday, with the repair clause and the capped increases both spelled out clearly.
Ratna: That works for me. I'd rather have this slightly uncomfortable conversation now than resent a decision made under pressure later.

quiz.question: Why did Ratna want to speak with Pak Joko before the renewal notice arrived?
options: To avoid scrambling once the formal notice arrived
To ask for a shorter lease
quiz.explanation: Ratna says she wanted to talk before the notice arrives rather than scrambling once it does.

quiz.question: What specific problem does Ratna cite as evidence of poor maintenance?
options: A leaking pipe in the hallway reported three months ago and still unfixed
quiz.explanation: She mentions the leaking pipe reported three months earlier that still hasn't been repaired.

quiz.question: What compromise does Ratna propose regarding the rent increase?
options: A smaller six percent increase, contingent on repairs being completed within a month
Paying the full twelve percent immediately
quiz.explanation: She proposes a six percent increase conditional on the outstanding repairs being finished within a month.

quiz.question: What does Pak Joko want in exchange for the lower increase?
options: A two-year commitment instead of the usual twelve months
quiz.explanation: Pak Joko asks for a two-year lease rather than the usual one-year term.

quiz.question: What additional clause does Ratna request for future years?
options: That future increases won't exceed inflation
quiz.explanation: Ratna asks for a clause capping future increases at the rate of inflation.

quiz.question: Why does Ratna link the rent increase to repairs?
options: She wants higher costs matched by better maintenance
quiz.explanation: The unresolved leak weakens the case for a twelve-percent rise.

quiz.question: What makes the two-year lease useful to Pak Joko?
options: It gives him a reliable long-term tenant
quiz.explanation: Longer occupancy balances the lower increase.

quiz.question: Why will Pak Joko put the terms in writing?
options: Ratna should see firm conditions before committing
quiz.explanation: Written terms make the repair and rent promises verifiable.

quiz.question: What shared interest helps them reach agreement?
options: Avoiding the costs and uncertainty of replacement
quiz.explanation: Both benefit from a stable, workable tenancy.

quiz.question: Which action occurs before the new contract is drafted?
options: Ratna pays two years in advance
A plumber is scheduled for the leak
quiz.explanation: Pak Joko promises repair action that week.
